evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion presented as a defensible position; no ratification language or permanence markers to lift it higher.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Confident declarative with a semicolon-balanced structure, but still an argued position rather than a settled operational rule or identity-level creed.

evidence.quote:

observations.why: Meta-commentary explaining the document's own rhetorical purpose; exploratory scaffolding rather than a conviction-bearing position itself.
